chapter: Southern Illinois roadhouse and St. Louis
title: Never on the riverboats; drinking through Jelly Roll's band
summary: Joe says he missed many details because of drinking, such as who was in Jelly Roll's band, and never worked a regular boat run.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: You weren't that familiar with Dewey Jackson's band, then. You didn't see much of them.

No. I missed a lot of those things. For the first thing... Like, when I played with Jelly Roll for two weeks, I don't remember nobody who was in that band. I did a lot of drinking, and I didn't pay no attention to who I was playing next to. Just so I got paid.
Well, it seems like most of the New Orleans guys that traveled, that came up the river or did whatever, they didn't leave the same way as you. I mean, you left on a medicine show and went around...
That's right. I never worked on a regular run on one of those boats.
I was going to ask you did you ever do anything like that.
No, no, I never did. Because like I said, I left New Orleans... Because I never stayed in New Orleans, and I never played around New Orleans much.
